vesna.root: Warden Vesna looks toward the blackened trees beyond the gate. Do you want to know what started the blight?
vesna.ask: Ask about the source of corruption
vesna.details: Dust and dark whispers are spreading from the crypts. Villagers have vanished. First stop the corrupted creatures outside the gate, then report back.

actI.hub: Vesna unfurls the frontier map. Which trail will you follow?

trail_of_black_ash.active: Trace the corruption to its origin among the twisted trees.
trail_of_black_ash.ready: You found where the blight first spread.
trail_of_black_ash.briefing: Follow the ash. It leads to the heart of the blight.

blighted_pack.active: Track down and defeat the corrupted boars in the wilderness.
blighted_pack.briefing: The beasts came from the old burial grounds. Do not let them reach the town.

forgotten_graves.active: Find the old headstones beyond the forest.
forgotten_graves.ready: The abandoned graveyard has been found.
forgotten_graves.briefing: No one has entered those grounds in years, yet we still hear its bells.

morrow_gravebound.active: Defeat Morrow, the named guardian of the graves.
morrow_gravebound.ready: Morrow is fallen and the graves are quiet.
morrow_gravebound.briefing: Morrow once protected the dead from desecration. Now he serves the corruption.

seal_of_rot.active: Find evidence that leads to the dark entrance of the crypt.
seal_of_rot.ready: Evidence of the crypt has been secured.
seal_of_rot.briefing: The seal belonged to an ancient house. Its king may never have truly rested.

crypt_descent.active: Enter the Crypt of the Hollow Crown through its gate.
crypt_descent.briefing: Leave the daylight behind, but remember the way home.

crypt_lord_fallen.active: Defeat the Crypt Lord and break the blight at its source.
crypt_lord_fallen.briefing: Corruption has festered here for generations. End it at the source.

vesnas_report.active: Return to town and tell Vesna of your victory.
vesnas_report.briefing: Bring word from the crypt. The town must know the cost of your victory.

town.futureService: This service is reserved for a later game update.
town.stashProtected: Locked and favorite items cannot be deposited. Stored items remain with your character across sessions.

warden_vesna.name: Warden Vesna
warden_vesna.description: The watch commander collects reports of dangers beyond the gate.

merchant_bram.name: Merchant Bram
merchant_bram.description: Sells weapons and armor for journeys into the wastes.

smith_odan.name: Blacksmith Odan
smith_odan.description: Permanently upgrades your equipment for gold.

potion_vendor_lena.name: Apothecary Lena
potion_vendor_lena.description: Restores your combat resource for 12 gold and sells one-charge refills for your potions.

stash_camp.name: Camp Stash
stash_camp.description: A personal chest with 24 slots. Stored equipment survives new world sessions.

waypoint_camp.name: Camp Waypoint
waypoint_camp.description: An ancient travel marker. Activate it to travel between previously awakened waypoints.

civilian_mira.name: Mira
civilian_mira.description: A local resident tending the fire and supplies.

civilian_toma.name: Toma
civilian_toma.description: A weary traveler sheltering from corruption.

civilian_lio.name: Lio
civilian_lio.description: A young courier learning the old road signs.

menu.subtitle: The dark frontier awaits
menu.help: Choose your hero. Progress saves automatically. Each new session generates a fresh wilderness layout.

status.loaded: Hero loaded — a fresh world awaits

controls.move: Move: click or hold left mouse
controls.hint: Space: evade · Shift: stand still · Q/RMB and 1: cursor-aimed skills · Esc → Controls to remap
controls.skills: Skills: Q / right mouse button and key 1
controls.avoid: Dodge the red warning circle before the strike lands.
controls.navigate: Hold left click to follow the cursor; click solid ground to move beside obstacles. Middle click forces movement.

footer.legacy: The original game is still available separately on GitHub Pages

inventory.title: Inventory & Equipment
inventory.invalidPlacement: Cannot place here. Choose a compatible slot or cancel move.
inventory.twoHandPreview: Equipping this two-handed item also removes your off-hand item.

creation.overwriteWarning: Creating a new hero replaces the current saved character and world progress.
creation.multiSlotHint: New heroes have separate save slots. Your existing characters will be kept.

WARRIOR.name: Warrior
WARRIOR.desc: A resilient fighter building rage in close combat.

PALADIN.name: Paladin
PALADIN.desc: A holy defender wielding faith and divine power.

MAGE.name: Mage
MAGE.desc: An elemental caster who strikes from a safe distance.

ROGUE.name: Rogue
ROGUE.desc: A nimble assassin relying on agility and critical strikes.

NECROMANCER.name: Necromancer
NECROMANCER.desc: Commands death and channels the essence of fallen foes.

WARLOCK.name: Warlock
WARLOCK.desc: A dark channeler wielding curses and soul power.

combat.dodge: Red ground markers show dangerous zones. Click outside to dodge.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.desc: A powerful melee attack dealing increased physical damage.

charge.name: Charge
charge.desc: Rush toward an enemy, strike, and briefly stun it.

judgment.name: Judgment
judgment.desc: A focused strike of holy light at a distant target.

consecration.name: Consecration
consecration.desc: Consecrate the ground, healing the hero and damaging nearby enemies.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.desc: A fiery strike that burns an enemy for several seconds.

frostNova.name: Frost Nova
frostNova.desc: Damage and slow nearby enemies with a surge of cold.

shadowDash.name: Dash
shadowDash.desc: Dash toward the pointer through navigable terrain, briefly evading attacks.

poisonBlade.name: Poison Blade
poisonBlade.desc: Strike an enemy and apply damage over time with poison.

boneSpear.name: Bone Spear
boneSpear.desc: Launch a piercing spear of bone toward the target.

raiseSkeleton.name: Raise Skeleton
raiseSkeleton.desc: Summon a real skeletal ally that follows and attacks nearby foes.

lifeDrain.name: Life Drain
lifeDrain.desc: Damage a target and heal the hero for part of the damage dealt.

soulBurn.name: Soul Burn
soulBurn.desc: Curse an enemy with lingering soulfire damage.

shadowBolt.name: Shadow Bolt
shadowBolt.desc: Launch a shadow projectile at a visible enemy.

demonSummoning.name: Demon Summoning
demonSummoning.desc: Summon a real demon ally. Command up to three demons at once.

corruption.name: Corruption
corruption.desc: Curse a target and inflict persistent poison damage.

fear.name: Fear
fear.desc: Briefly incapacitate an enemy and silence its spells.

hellfire.name: Hellfire
hellfire.desc: Blast nearby enemies with fire and apply burning damage over time.

basicAttack.name: Basic Attack
basicAttack.desc: A melee hit that generates Rage when it connects.

groundSlam.name: Ground Slam
groundSlam.desc: After a short wind-up, hit and stun enemies around the hero.

warCry.name: War Cry
warCry.desc: Gain Rage, increase movement speed and strengthen defenses briefly.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: Channel a flurry of repeated hits against nearby enemies.

execute.name: Execute
execute.desc: A powerful strike dealing extra damage to weakened enemies.

holyStrike.name: Holy Strike
holyStrike.desc: A close-range radiant blow that restores Faith when it lands.

divineShield.name: Divine Shield
divineShield.desc: Conjure a protective barrier and gain Fortified for six seconds.

healingLight.name: Healing Light
healingLight.desc: Spend Faith to restore health; holy-caster talents strengthen the heal.

holyAura.name: Holy Aura
holyAura.desc: Regenerate health and gain protection while searing nearby enemies.

smite.name: Smite
smite.desc: Send a powerful ranged holy strike and leave enemies Vulnerable.

chainLightning.name: Chain Lightning
chainLightning.desc: A lightning strike that jumps through nearby visible enemies and briefly stuns them.

meteor.name: Meteor
meteor.desc: Call a fiery impact at the mouse position, burning enemies in the blast.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.desc: Move instantly to a clear destination along an unobstructed path.

arcaneBarrier.name: Arcane Barrier
arcaneBarrier.desc: Consume Mana to create a temporary protective shield.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.desc: Summon a lingering frost storm at the cursor, damaging and chilling enemies.

corpseExplosion.name: Corpse Explosion
corpseExplosion.desc: Detonate a nearby fresh corpse, harming and poisoning enemies in its radius.

bloodDrain.name: Blood Drain
bloodDrain.desc: Drain an enemy's life through shadow magic and restore health from damage dealt.

curse.name: Curse
curse.desc: Weaken an enemy and make it more vulnerable for six seconds.

summonGolem.name: Summon Golem
summonGolem.desc: Create a durable, level-scaled golem that follows and attacks enemies.

deathNova.name: Death Nova
deathNova.desc: Blast nearby enemies with poisonous death magic.

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.desc: Strike a nearby target; attacks from behind or from stealth deal much greater damage. Daggers gain a bonus.

multishot.name: Multishot
multishot.desc: Fire a piercing spread at up to five enemies ahead. Bow and crossbow attacks deal increased damage.

shadowStep.name: Shadow Step
shadowStep.desc: Step behind a targeted enemy without crossing walls and become briefly concealed.

trap.name: Poison Trap
trap.desc: Place a trap that roots and poisons the first enemy entering its radius. Three traps maximum.

fanOfKnives.name: Fan of Knives
fanOfKnives.desc: Strike all nearby visible enemies and apply bleeding.

wraith.name: Wraith
wraith.desc: A ranged foe. Casts a dark bolt and retreats from melee attackers.

skeleton.name: Skeleton Warrior
skeleton.desc: A close-range fighter with a sweeping attack.

wolf.name: Corrupted Wolf
wolf.desc: A fast hunter. Leaps into a marked area and poisons anyone it catches.

crypt_lord.name: Crypt Lord
crypt_lord.desc: An ancient ruler of the tomb. Heavily armored with a sweeping attack.

merchant.name: Merchant Bram
merchant.description: Whatever survives the road, I will buy. Whatever you're missing, I can sell.

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith Odan
blacksmith.description: Steel is only as good as the hand that tempers it.

ashes.title: Ashes at the Gate
ashes.unstarted: Warden Vesna has a task for you.
ashes.intro: Our last patrol vanished beyond the old road. Shadows draw close to camp, and the fires are fading. Slay three corrupted creatures in the wilderness, then return for your reward.
ashes.inProgress: The fire still protects us, but danger waits beyond the stone road. Defeat three enemies and report back.
ashes.readyDialogue: The road breathes again. I saw the shadows scatter. You have earned the watch's reward.
ashes.finishDialogue: You have done more than we dared hope. Emberwatch is always open to you, wanderer.

trail_of_black_ash.title: Trail of Black Ash
trail_of_black_ash.description: Vesna sends you beyond the gates to trace the source of black ash. Unnatural whispers cling to the treetops.

blighted_pack.title: The Blighted Pack
blighted_pack.description: The tracks lead to infected beasts. Their hunger is unnatural and their blood fouls the soil.

forgotten_graves.title: The Forgotten Graves
forgotten_graves.description: An abandoned graveyard lies beside the old road. A voice beneath the earth calls the dead by name.

morrow_gravebound.title: Morrow, Gravebound
morrow_gravebound.description: Morrow, the graveyard warden, succumbed to the blight and now guards an ancient seal. End his watch.

seal_of_rot.title: The Seal of Rot
seal_of_rot.description: A clue remains among the ruined graves, pointing toward the crypt. Recover evidence of the power below.
seal_of_rot.objective: Recover evidence leading to the crypt

crypt_descent.title: Descent into the Crypt
crypt_descent.description: The dark gate stands open. Descend and discover who feeds the corruption above.

crypt_lord_fallen.title: The Crypt Lord Falls
crypt_lord_fallen.description: The Lord of the Hollow Crown awakens the dead and poisons the frontier. Destroy him in his hall.

vesnas_report.title: Report to Vesna
vesnas_report.description: The source of corruption is silenced. Return to Warden Vesna with the truth and claim your reward.

actI.returnToVesna: Return to Warden Vesna and claim the reward.
actI.nextUnlocked: Act I complete. The next chapter is unlocked.

error.protected: Locked or favorite items cannot be sold.
error.invalid: The trade could not be completed.

trade.bagFull: Your backpack is full. Sell an item to free a slot.
trade.noItems: You have no items in your backpack.
trade.temperHint: The blacksmith permanently improves equipped weapons and armor for gold (up to three times). Equip an item from your inventory first.
trade.noForgeable: Equip a weapon or armor in your inventory, then return to the blacksmith.

dungeon.name: Crypt of the Hollow Crown
dungeon.gateHint: A sealed crypt lies beyond the camp. Enter and purge its darkness.
dungeon.guardsHint: Defeat three stronger guardians to awaken the ruler beneath
dungeon.bossHint: Defeat the Crypt Lord and two retainers. Dodge its wide sweeping attacks.
dungeon.clearedHint: The ruler has fallen. Keep your gold, loot and XP; the world resets next session.

character.title: Character and Attributes
character.derivedHint: Stats are derived from class and equipped items. Resistances, dodge, block and some secondary values are informational for now; applying them in combat belongs to the next prompt.

bindings.title: Input bindings
bindings.help: Choose an action, then press Ctrl, Alt, or Shift with a key. Release a modifier alone to bind that key. Escape cancels.
bindings.reserved: Browser/system shortcuts, Meta combinations, and Ctrl+Alt (AltGr) cannot be assigned. Future panels are not active. Controls are saved on this device.
bindings.CONFLICT: This key or button is already assigned.
bindings.INVALID: That key or button is not supported.

worldObjects.shrine: The soul shrine grants a protective shield.

map.title: World Map
map.legend: Only explored terrain and real roads are shown. Dark areas are unknown; discover locations by travelling. Drag to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom.

hollowKing.name: The Hollow King
hollowKing.phase2: Phase II — Rise of the Dead

respawn.title: You Have Fallen
respawn.description: Combat has ended. Your equipment, level, and quest progress are preserved.
respawn.checkpointActivated: Soul Shrine activated as a respawn checkpoint.

talents.title: Warrior Talent Tree
talents.warriorOnly: Warrior talent branches are available only to Warriors.

battleFury.name: Battle Fury
battleFury.description: Generate +2 Rage per rank on successful attacks and War Cry; +3 maximum Rage per rank.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.description: Increase attack speed by 6% per rank. Speeds up basic attack and melee windups.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.description: Gain +2.5% critical strike chance per rank.

lastStand.name: Last Stand
lastStand.description: Deal +14% damage per rank while at or below 40% health.

ironSkin.name: Iron Skin
ironSkin.description: Gain +16 armor per rank, increasing physical damage resistance.

shieldMastery.name: Shield Mastery
shieldMastery.description: Gain +4% block chance per rank, up to the standard cap.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.description: War Cry also grants a shield worth 8% of maximum health per rank.

commandingCry.name: Commanding Cry
commandingCry.description: War Cry haste and fortification last 1.5 seconds longer per rank.

shockwave.name: Shockwave
shockwave.description: Extend stuns from Warrior combat skills by 0.25 seconds per rank.

warDrums.name: War Drums
warDrums.description: War Cry grants +5 additional Rage and +0.2 resource regeneration per rank.

commander.name: Commander
commander.description: Increase War Cry haste and fortification magnitude by +6 percentage points per rank.

zeal.name: Zeal
zeal.description: Increase damage dealt by Holy attacks by 8% per rank.

righteousFire.name: Righteous Fire
righteousFire.description: Increase critical strike chance by 1.6 points per rank.

bulwark.name: Bulwark of Faith
bulwark.description: Strengthen Divine Shield by 12% per rank.

hymn.name: Hymn of Light
hymn.description: Strengthen Holy Aura effects by 15% per rank.

benediction.name: Benediction
benediction.description: Extend Holy Aura's duration by two seconds per rank.

prayer.name: Faithful Prayer
prayer.description: Increase Faith regeneration by 0.8 per second per rank.

inquisition.name: Inquisition
inquisition.description: Improve Healing Light by 12% per rank.

ember.name: Ember
ember.description: Increase Mage spell damage by 4% per rank.

pyromancy.name: Pyromancy
pyromancy.description: Increase burn duration by 15% per rank.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.description: Expand ground-spell area by 8% per rank.

rime.name: Rime
rime.description: Increase chilling slow intensity by 5 percentage points per rank.

frostbite.name: Frostbite
frostbite.description: Increase chill duration by 12% per rank.

permafrost.name: Permafrost
permafrost.description: Increase Mana regeneration by 0.07 per second per rank.

spark.name: Spark
spark.description: Increase Chain Lightning damage by 5% per rank.

conduction.name: Conduction
conduction.description: Increase critical chance by 2.5 percentage points per rank.

tempest.name: Tempest
tempest.description: Add one extra Chain Lightning jump per rank.

focus.name: Arcane Focus
focus.description: Reduce extra spell Mana costs by 4% per rank.

aegis.name: Arcane Aegis
aegis.description: Add 7% of maximum health to Arcane Barrier per rank.

transcendence.name: Transcendence
transcendence.description: Reduce Teleport cooldown by 7% per rank.

boneSpear.name: Piercing Bones
boneSpear.description: Bone Spear deals 11% more damage per rank.

boneFracture.name: Bone Fracture
boneFracture.description: Corpse Explosion reaches 10% farther per rank.

corpseMastery.name: Corpse Mastery
corpseMastery.description: Corpse Explosion poison damage increases by 20% per rank.

legion.name: Raised Legion
legion.description: Skeletons deal 14% more damage and grow stronger per rank.

golemCore.name: Golem Core
golemCore.description: Your golem gains 14% more summoning power per rank.

soulLink.name: Soul Link
soulLink.description: Skeletons and golems have 12% more maximum health per rank.

bloodTithe.name: Blood Tithe
bloodTithe.description: Blood Drain heals an additional 9% of damage dealt per rank.

crimsonCurse.name: Crimson Curse
crimsonCurse.description: Curses and vulnerability last 15% longer per rank.

plagueNova.name: Plague Nova
plagueNova.description: Death Nova covers 9% more distance per rank.

precision.name: Assassin's Precision
precision.description: Gain 2 percentage points of critical chance per rank.

execution.name: Execution
execution.description: Backstab deals 15% more damage per rank.

hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
hemorrhage.description: Fan of Knives bleeding lasts 20% longer per rank.

veil.name: Veil of Shadows
veil.description: Shadow Step grants 0.6 seconds more stealth per rank.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.description: Backstab deals another 15% damage per rank while stealthed.

shadowHaste.name: Shadow Haste
shadowHaste.description: Shadow Step grants 4 percentage points of extra Haste per rank.

venom.name: Venom Traps
venom.description: Traps deal 16% more poison damage per rank.

binding.name: Binding Wires
binding.description: Enemies remain rooted by traps 20% longer per rank.

serration.name: Serrated Trap
serration.description: Trap poison lasts 18% longer per rank.

abyssalPower.name: Abyssal Power
abyssalPower.description: Your demon gains 13% summoning power per rank.

demonBlood.name: Demon Blood
demonBlood.description: Your demon has 12% more maximum health per rank.

soulPact.name: Soul Pact
soulPact.description: Demon hits restore 2.5% of dealt damage as your health per rank.

blight.name: Blight
blight.description: Corruption poison damage increases by 16% per rank.

hex.name: Lingering Hex
hex.description: Corruption curse lasts 14% longer per rank.

torment.name: Torment
torment.description: Corruption's weakening curse grows by 4 percentage points per rank.

shadowBolt.name: Shadow Bolt Mastery
shadowBolt.description: Shadow Bolt deals 13% more shadow damage per rank.

soulFeast.name: Soul Feast
soulFeast.description: Shadow Bolt heals you for 7% of dealt damage per rank.

crafting.title: Crafting and Salvage
crafting.description: Salvage gear into materials and modify items at the blacksmith. Socketing here creates an empty socket only; gems and runes come later.
crafting.protected: Locked and favorite items cannot be crafted or salvaged.

gems.title: Gems and Runes
gems.description: Forge gems from materials, combine three identical stones into a higher tier, and insert them into empty sockets. Effects depend on the equipment category. Extraction costs gold and returns the stone to your wallet.
gems.emptyWallet: You do not own any gems or runes yet.
gems.noSocketedGear: No socketable gear in your bag or equipment. You can add an empty socket through Crafting.

stash.noMatches: No items match the current filters.

waypoints.title: Fast Travel
waypoints.requireActivation: Visit and activate a waypoint before using it. Travel only works while standing near an activated waypoint.
waypoints.nearSource: Approach an activated waypoint to travel.

feedback.lockedDoor: The sealed door has been opened.
feedback.hiddenWall: A hidden passage has been revealed.

saveSlots.title: Saved heroes
saveSlots.full: All character slots are occupied. Delete one to create a new hero.

visualSettings.title: Display and accessibility
visualSettings.description: These preferences are saved in this browser, separate from your hero and world.
visualSettings.fullscreenDenied: The browser did not allow fullscreen mode.

audioSettings.description: Original synthesized effects. Sound starts only after a key press or pointer gesture. These settings apply to this browser.
